name: micron-backoffice-golden
description: Golden regression suite for the back-office email agent: 2 normal examples per document type plus one example per planted flaw and one out-of-scope case.

messages.content:
From: dispatch@sableridgematerials.com
Subject: Pickup request - stainless sheet to Fab 11

Hi logistics team,

Please arrange a truckload pickup of the 304 stainless sheet order for Fab 11. We have 25 sheets (4x8ft, 16ga) ready, total weight approximately 9,800 lbs. We can have it ready for pickup on 2026-08-24.

Shipper: Sable Ridge Materials, 4100 Foundry Rd, Twin Falls, ID
Consignee: Fab 11 - Boise, ID

Thanks,
Sable Ridge Materials Dispatch

outputs.reference_answer: A shipping order was created for Sable Ridge Materials shipping 25 stainless sheets to Fab 11 - Boise, ID, with pickup on 2026-08-24.
outputs.expected_behavior: Should extract shipper, consignee, items, and pickup date and post a shipping order via create_shipping_order without needing escalation.

messages.content:
From: logistics@vantagepointelec.com
Subject: Air freight needed - component kits to Singapore

Hello,

We need to air-ship the SMD component kits (resistor + capacitor assortments, 400 units combined, ~140 lbs) to the Singapore Fab as soon as possible - production is waiting on these. Pickup can happen tomorrow, 2026-08-21, from our San Jose warehouse.

Shipper: Vantage Point Electronics
Consignee: Singapore Fab - Woodlands

Regards,
Vantage Point Electronics Logistics

outputs.reference_answer: A shipping order was created for Vantage Point Electronics air-shipping SMD component kits to the Singapore Fab, pickup 2026-08-21.
outputs.expected_behavior: Should post a shipping order with mode reasonably inferred as air freight.

messages.content:
From: procurement.boise@micron.com
Subject: New PO needed - additional aluminum brackets

Hi procurement,

We're running low on Type-C aluminum brackets ahead of the next production run. Please place a new order with Northfield Components for 600 units at their standard unit price ($12.40). Requested delivery date is 2026-09-10, ship to Fab 11 - Boise.

Thanks,
Fab 11 Manufacturing Engineering

outputs.reference_answer: A new purchase order was created with Northfield Components for 600 aluminum brackets at $12.40/unit, requested delivery 2026-09-10, shipped to Fab 11 - Boise.
outputs.expected_behavior: Should create a new PO via create_purchase_order after validating Northfield Components against the ERP.

messages.content:
From: procurement.sg@micron.com
Subject: New order - SMD component kits

Hello,

Please place an order with Vantage Point Electronics for 300 SMD resistor kits (0603 assorted, $9.75 each) and 300 SMD capacitor kits (0805 assorted, $11.25 each). Requested delivery 2026-09-08, ship to Singapore Fab - Woodlands.

Thanks,
Singapore Fab Procurement

outputs.reference_answer: A new purchase order was created with Vantage Point Electronics for 300 SMD resistor kits and 300 SMD capacitor kits, requested delivery 2026-09-08, shipped to Singapore Fab.
outputs.expected_behavior: Should create a new PO with both line items captured correctly.

messages.content:
From: ap@northfieldcomponents.com
Subject: Invoice INV-88213 for PO-10045

Hi team,

Please find our invoice INV-88213 for PO-10045: 480 units of precision aluminum brackets at $12.40/unit, total $5,952.00, due net 30 (2026-09-20).

Thanks,
Northfield Components AP Team

outputs.reference_answer: Invoice INV-88213 from Northfield Components was posted against PO-10045 for $5,952.00, due 2026-09-20.
outputs.expected_behavior: Should validate the vendor and PO against the ERP and post the invoice with the correct total.

messages.content:
From: billing@vantagepointelec.com
Subject: Invoice VP-33210 for PO-10088

Hello,

Invoice VP-33210 against PO-10088:
- SMD resistor kit, 0603 assorted: 200 units @ $9.75 = $1,950.00
- SMD capacitor kit, 0805 assorted: 200 units @ $11.25 = $2,250.00

Total: $4,200.00. Due net 30 (2026-09-25).

Thanks,
Vantage Point Electronics Billing

outputs.reference_answer: Invoice VP-33210 from Vantage Point Electronics was posted against PO-10088 for a total of $4,200.00, matching both line items.
outputs.expected_behavior: Should post the invoice with total_amount of $4,200.00, matching the sum of both line items.

messages.content:
From: treasury@micron.com
Subject: Remittance advice - payment to Northfield Components

Hi,

This confirms payment of $5,952.00 to Northfield Components, settling invoice INV-88213. Payment reference: ACH-771029.

Thanks,
Micron Treasury

outputs.reference_answer: A remittance advice was recorded matching payment reference ACH-771029 to invoice INV-88213 for $5,952.00 to Northfield Components.
outputs.expected_behavior: Should match the single invoice and amount and post the remittance.

messages.content:
From: treasury@micron.com
Subject: Remittance advice - Vantage Point Electronics, two invoices

Hi,

Payment reference WIRE-550298 settles two Vantage Point Electronics invoices: VP-33210 for $4,200.00 and VP-33255 for $2,975.00.

Thanks,
Micron Treasury

outputs.reference_answer: A remittance advice was recorded for payment reference WIRE-550298, matching two Vantage Point Electronics invoices: VP-33210 for $4,200.00 and VP-33255 for $2,975.00.
outputs.expected_behavior: Should match both invoice numbers to their respective amounts.

messages.content:
From: ap@northfieldcomponents.com
Subject: Invoice for units from your recent shipment

Hi team,

Please find our invoice for the 500 aluminum brackets from your recent order, at $12.40/unit, total $6,200.00, due net 30 (2026-09-27). Invoice number NC-9910.

Thanks,
Northfield Components AP Team

outputs.expected_behavior: The email gives no PO number and only vaguely references 'your recent order' with a different quantity (500) than the only PO on file for this vendor (480 units on PO-10045). The agent should ask for clarification or leave the PO unresolved rather than assuming PO-10045 is the right order.

messages.content:
From: ap@balticcircuitworks.com
Subject: Invoice BCW-2201 for PO-10140

Hi,

Invoice BCW-2201 against PO-10140: 500 units of 6-layer custom PCB at $18.20/unit, total $9,100.00 USD. Due net 30 (2026-09-30).

Thanks,
Baltic Circuit Works AP

outputs.expected_behavior: Baltic Circuit Works is an EUR vendor in the ERP, but this invoice is stated in USD. The agent should flag the currency mismatch (escalate or ask for clarification) rather than posting it as-is.

messages.content:
From: ap@delacroixfreight.com
Subject: Invoice DFL-1102 for PO-99981

Hi,

Invoice DFL-1102 against PO-99981: linehaul freight service, 1 unit at $3,450.00, total $3,450.00. Due net 15 (2026-09-05).

Thanks,
Delacroix Freight & Logistics AP

outputs.expected_behavior: PO-99981 does not exist in the ERP, so validation should fail and the document should be escalated to a human reviewer with a ticket that is actually filed, not silently dropped.

messages.content:
From: ap@sableridgematerials.com
Subject: Invoice for your recent order PO-10071

Hi team,

Invoice SR-9044 for PO-10071: 25 sheets of 304 stainless (4x8ft, 16ga) at $210.00/sheet, total $5,250.00, due net 30 (2026-09-23). This is an invoice, not a new order request - please process for payment.

Thanks,
Sable Ridge Materials AP

outputs.expected_behavior: Despite the word 'order' appearing in the subject line, the body is clearly an invoice for goods already delivered against an existing PO. It should be classified and processed as an invoice, not as a new purchase order request.

messages.content:
From: ap@ironharborfab.com
Subject: Invoice IH-5602 with partial credit for damaged units

Hi,

Invoice IH-5602 against PO-10093: 15 welded steel frame assemblies at $640.00/unit, subtotal $9,600.00. Two units arrived damaged in transit, so we're applying a credit of -$1,280.00 for those units. Net amount due: $8,320.00, net 30 (2026-09-24).

Thanks,
Iron Harbor Fabrication AP

outputs.expected_behavior: This invoice includes a partial credit for damaged units, which the invoice-posting tool does not support. The agent should escalate to a human rather than posting an incorrect amount.

messages.content:
From: ap@cascadeprecision.com
Subject: Invoice CP-4402 - Cascade Precision

Hi,

Invoice CP-4402 for 40 units of precision-machined housing at $96.50/unit, total $3,860.00, due net 30 (2026-09-28).

Thanks,
Cascade Precision AP

outputs.expected_behavior: The vendor reference 'Cascade Precision' is ambiguous between two ERP records (Cascade Precision Machining and Cascade Precision Manufacturing). The agent should escalate or ask for clarification after at most one lookup, not repeatedly retry the same ambiguous lookup.

messages.content:
From: ap@sableridgematerials.com
Subject: Invoice SR-9077 for PO-10071

Hi,

Invoice SR-9077 against PO-10071: 25 sheets of 304 stainless (4x8ft, 16ga) at $210.00/sheet. Total due: $5,700.00, net 30 (2026-09-23).

Thanks,
Sable Ridge Materials AP

outputs.expected_behavior: The line items (25 sheets x $210.00 = $5,250.00) do not match the vendor's stated total of $5,700.00. The agent should catch this discrepancy and flag it rather than posting the padded total as-is.

messages.content:
From: broker@globalcustomsadvisors.com
Subject: HTS classification question for upcoming import

Hi,

We're preparing the customs paperwork for an upcoming import and need to confirm the correct HTS classification code for the precision-machined aluminum components before they ship. Can someone from your compliance team advise on the correct code and applicable duty rate?

Thanks,
Global Customs Advisors

outputs.reference_answer: This is a customs/HTS classification inquiry, not a shipping order, purchase order, invoice, or remittance advice, and should be routed to a human reviewer rather than processed automatically.
outputs.expected_behavior: Should be classified as out_of_scope and escalated, not force-fit into one of the four document types.
